name: Kazeiro Surf
source:
In 1903, a manned airplane successfully fllew in the sky. Yes, that was the moment when humans got wings. 
As tensions between countries flared, airplanes were used as weapons. WWI finally broke out in 1914... eventually the war ended, but a lot of countries still held animosity with each other. 
In 1923, Erika, a mechanic, and her family lived in Juktland. Her father, Anthony, was also a mechanic. Though he was old, he was still called the 'God of Repair'. Erika was also a good mechanic. One day, Anthony received a command from the Juktland Army. It was to be a airplane mechanic for the Roby Independent Aerial Platoon. Erika didn't want him to overwork himself, so she said, "I'll go in behalf of him." Like this, she was sent to an air base near the border. However, when soldiers first saw her, some despised her, some expected something from her, and some felt disappointed... No one treated her as a full-fledged mechanic... She finally said, "I'm here as a mechanic. Give me something to do!"

[Edited from Himeya Shop]
translation:
1903年，载人飞机成功飞上天空。没错，那正是人类获得翅膀的瞬间。
随着各国紧张局势加剧，飞机开始被用作武器。1914年，第一次世界大战终于爆发…战争最终结束，许多国家之间却仍怀有敌意。
1923年，机械师艾丽卡与家人生活在Juktland。父亲安东尼同样是一名机械师，尽管年事已高，仍被人称作“维修之神”。艾丽卡也拥有出色的机械技术。一天，安东尼接到Juktland军队命令，要前往Roby独立航空小队担任飞机机械师。艾丽卡不愿父亲过度操劳，于是说道：“我替他去。”就这样，她被派往边境附近的空军基地。然而，士兵们初次见到她时，有人轻蔑，有人期待，也有人失望…没有人把她当作一名真正的机械师…最后，她终于说道：“我是以机械师身份来到这里的。给我安排工作！”
